headline: Downed Japanese Zero Found Intact on Alaskan Island, Navy to Study Craft
dispatch: A Mitsubishi Zero fighter aircraft was discovered on July 10, 1942, lying largely undamaged in a peat bog on Akutan Island, Alaska, after its pilot was killed in a crash landing following a raid on Dutch Harbor. Navy salvage teams recovered the aircraft, which was subsequently repaired and test-flown at Naval Air Station North Island. Intelligence gained from the examination proved valuable in developing tactics used by American pilots against the Zero throughout the Pacific campaign.
answer: Intact Japanese Zero found on Akutan Island, Alaska, 1942
